name: Scheme for Persons with Benchmark Disability Requiring High Support
benefit:
Financial Assistance (one-time payment) of ₹40,000/- for the following purposes:

- Assistive technologies and required aids/appliances.
- Personal care assistance services.
- Educational or vocational training support.

##### ***Conditions***

- _The scheme can be availed once every five years, subject to reassessment of eligibility._
- _Funds will be recovered if they are found to be misused or
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must satisfy the following conditions to apply for financial assistance under this scheme. - The applicant must be a bona fide resident of the State of Goa by birth, by marriage, or through continuous domicile of at least fifteen years. - The applicant must be a person with a benchmark disability requiring high support. - The applicant must possess a certificate issued by the Medical Board notified by the State Government under Section 38 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. - The applicant must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category as per the Government of India or the State Government’s notified criteria. - The applicant must not be receiving similar financial assistance from other Government or Non-Government sources for the same purpose. - The applicant must submit a self-declaration confirming that they are not receiving similar assistance from other sources. ***Relaxation*** Exceptions to the residence requirement may be allowed for certain special cases (e.g., persons married into Goa).
